notes.title: Trainatic Release - Updates & Changes!
notes.notes:
[p]Hello Everyone!  A big thanks to everyone playing the game and providing feedback! Today's update will include some balance changes to the end game, specifically for those trying to grind out the end game orb achievements. [/p][p][/p][p]In true incremental fashion, the end game was always suppose to be a bit more grindy for those players that like to go the extra mile. However, the current balancing of the end game is a bit over tuned from what I would like it to be. These changes will make it so getting to a higher orb level still requires a grind but overall it should feel like a nicer journey.[/p][p][/p][h3]Endgame Changes[/h3][list][*][p]Reduced the increase in difficulty per orb caught in a map. This change will be more noticeable when you have 10+ orbs on a map[/p][/*][*][p]Added a max speed end game upgrade to the tree[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the density of resources in the final map. Reaching a higher orb level in this map should be easier now that there are more resources to get fuel from destroying[/p][/*][*][p]Added a fuel gained per tile destroyed end game upgrade to the tree[/p][/*][*][p]Added a fuel efficiency end game upgrade to the tree[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Since launch there has also been a few small bug fixes and changes! I'll recap them here in this post in case they were missed.[/p][p][/p][h3]General Changes[/h3][p][/p][p]The minigun was feeling a bit underwhelming when first unlocked and with this update I hope that changes![/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Increased the base damage of the minigun from 50 to 175[/p][/*][*][p]The bullets are visually larger in size and have a bigger hitbox[/p][/*][*][p]The base distance minigun bullets travel has been increased by around 25%[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the accuracy of the minigun by about 50%. [/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45491581/76238624a7521f63ffbe26ff5d4952dc923324ee.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]additional changes:[/p][list][*][p]updated a lightning spire upgrade icon[/p][/*][*][p]resources will now spawn on previously visited parts of the track. This makes it so if the track goes back over an older part of the track there will be more resources there to destroy.[/p][/*][*][p]A few small controller improvements for navigating the UI[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]bug fixes[/h3][list][*][p]fixed a few Japanese translations[/p][/*][*][p]fixed a bug on controller and steamdeck where the main menu would sometimes jump back up to "new game" when the player first does an input.[/p][/*][*][p]fixed a bug with the UI appearing incorrectly sometimes when returning to the station or quick starting a run.[/p][/*][*][p]fixed a bug where parts of the UI were being displayed behind other parts of UI when they shouldn't be.[/p][/*][*][p]fixed a visual bug where the game would appear blurry on certain monitors[/p][/*][*][p]fixed a visual bug where the intensity of bloom was way higher than intended on certain monitors[/p][/*][*][p]fixed a visual bug where the games vignette would appear way more intense on certain monitors[/p][/*][*][p]fixed a bug where the achievement for reaching orb level 15 was not unlocking. Running out of fuel or catching the orb in a map with level 15 or higher should unlock the achievement.[/p][/*][*][p]fixed a bug where the Japanese, Russian, Ukrainian, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese were not displaying correctly on the UI[/p][/*][*][p]fixed a bug where the orb catcher upgrades would not unlock when using quick return to station[/p][/*][*][p]fixed a bug on windows 11 that would sometimes cause the desktop icon to not display correctly[/p][/*][/list][p]

 ----------------------------------------- [/p][p] [url="https://store.steampowered.com/developer/RyanForrester"]follow my developer page on steam[/url] to be notified when any of my new games release![/p]

notes.title: 🚂 Trainatic Next Fest Demo Update!
notes.notes:
It has been almost 2 weeks since the demo launch on Steam. For Next Fest, I wanted to have something a little extra to add to to the update as a thank you to everyone who checked out the game, provided feedback, and wrote reviews!

[h3]Shotgun Car[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45491581/4469a8618c6c94523a9816d73bf22df42b052c98.png[/img]

Added the shotgun car! You may have already guessed based on the name how this car will feel. The shotgun car can be a powerful addition to your train when placed next to the right support cars!

[h3]Milestones[/h3]

Milestones are another way to boost your trains power. Milestones can be progressed by using certain cars or just making progress down the track. Milestones are unlocked from the skill tree early on in the game.  

[h3]Additional Changes[/h3]

- Added a powerful upgrade to the grenade car.
- The orb catcher now requires the train to be going a certain speed before the orb starts getting detected. I've always wanted the orb to feel like something you had to race to catch.
- Balance changes throughout the skill tree
- Gamepad improvements
- Fixed a bug where the grenade car was sometimes not aiming properly on controller
- General bug fixes 

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/RyanForrester]follow my developer page on steam[/url] to be notified when any of my new games release!

Thanks for checking it out! 🚂

notes.title: Trainatic Demo - Patch #4
notes.notes:
[h3]Storage / Storage Car changes[/h3]

The goal with these changes is to make the storage cap during the first few runs less troublesome. The current state of the storage support felt a little awkward as well. For taking up a one whole spot on the train, it could be a little more powerful right when you unlock it.

[h3]Changes[/h3]

- The storage support car now adds +40 to max storage by default (previously 0) 
- Improved the description on the storage support car upgrade, so it's easier to tell what it actually does
- the base storage your train starts with is now 30 (previously 20)


[h3]Extras[/h3]

- When on a support car on the manage train screen, the visuals indicating whether a car is supported by the support car have been updated. Removed the red X and replaced it with a white dot.
- fixed a bug loading corrupted save files showing a blank grey screen. (like if the power goes out while the game is saving)

-----------------------------------------

notes.title: Trainatic Demo - Patch #3
notes.notes:
[h3]Grenade car changes[/h3]

The state of the grenade car at launch was maybe not up to par with how I would have liked it. There has been a lot of feedback on how it doesn't really feel good.

My vision for the grenade car was it was going to be slower than the spike shooter but be more, well, explosive. 

 - the base grenade explosion size is now 350% larger.
 - grenades base landing speed is 100% faster.
 - reduced the base fire rate. With how big the explosion is now, the base fire rate is roughly 2.5 seconds without fire rate upgrades.


[h3]Extras / Bugfixes / QoL[/h3]

- added a description to upgrades for support cars to better explain what a support car does
- added a description to armour
- added a description to fuel
- fixed a bug with upgrades appearing as if they could be purchased when they are in fact not
- added some text to the pause menu showing the hotkeys for quick depart and returning to the station
- fixed a bug where the mouse would not display if switching from controller to mouse and keyboard
- fixed a bug on the controller when trying to select a different car on the manage train screen

notes.title: Trainatic Demo - Patch #2
notes.notes:
A big thanks to everyone reporting bugs and providing feedback on the game - Over the coming weeks I'll be working on implementing your feedback to make the game the best it can be!

Today I have the following changes:

[h3]Balance changes[/h3]
- Added an "auto acceleration" upgrade to the tree. When you start a run you can press this new button near the speed bar to always automatically accelerate when you start a run.
- Added a bit more starting fuel. This should make the first few runs last slightly longer
- Increased the starting accuracy of the spike shooter
- Increased the starting fire rate of the spike shooter


[h3]Extra things / QoL[/h3]
- Added a setting to turn on/off the crt effect
- Changed "deaccelerate" (whoops) to "decelerate" in many places
- Added a volume slider for the train "chugging" sound
- fixed a bug with the settings button on the upgrade screen
- fixed a random crash caused by explosions
